## Imports
```{python}
import fastf1
import polars as pl
from pyprojroot import here
```

## Save Downloads
```{python}
## Cache - saves downloads so we don't have to redownload every time
cache_dir = here('data/f1_cache')
cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fastf1.Cache.enable_cache(str(cache_dir))

## Load one session (2026, round 1, Race)
session = fastf1.get_session(2026, 1, "R")
session.load(telemetry=True, weather=False, messages=False)

## See Laps
laps = session.laps
print(laps[['Driver', 'LapNumber', 'LapTime']].head())

## Telemetry for one lap (fastest lap of one driver)
lap = laps.pick_drivers('VER').pick_fastest()
car = laps.get_car_data().add_distance()
car_pl = pl.from_pandas(
    car[['Distance', 'Speed', 'Throttle', 'nGear', 'RPM', 'Brake']]
)
print(car_pl.head())

## Corner Locations (to find straights)
corners = session.get_circuit_info().corners
print(corners[['Number', 'Distance']])
```
